_meta.title: v8p15 infer-first: sweep progress_cost_sigma_m at w_clearance=1.5 (min_progress=-0.05) to reduce long detours
_meta.summary: v8p14 relaxes forest_min_progress_m to recover long SR at w_clearance=1.5, but long path/time still lags baseline. v8p15 keeps w_clearance=1.5 + min_progress=-0.05 and sweeps forest_progress_cost_sigma_m (clearance penalty decay length) to test whether tuning the clearance field smoothness can reduce long detours under SR≈1.0. Infer-only; loads v8p11 weights. Anti-cheating: do not change goal tolerances.
commands: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile v8p15
notes: Infer-only: loads models from v8p11; output dirs are under v8p15*.
Claim regime: shielded/hybrid (do not label as strict-argmax).
Anti-cheating: do NOT change goal_tolerance_m (and do not loosen stop thresholds) for evaluation.
Final gate C uses fixed pairs20 short/long with runs=20 each and baseline must be run together.
